# Datung

Datung is the business name of Dark Knight Lending, Inc., a lending company registered with the Philippine Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC Reg. No. 2024070157507-01, Certificate of Authority No. 3506).

Datung provides business loans and working capital financing to established Philippine SMEs, especially the suppliers and distributors who sell to small businesses on terms.

The application website, with current products, requirements and timing, is https://datungapply.com. A fuller summary is at https://datungapply.com/llms.txt.

Contact: sales@datung.io

## For institutional funders
Datung is an SEC-licensed Philippine SME lender (Certificate of Authority No. 3506). Information for banks, private credit funds, family offices and development finance institutions: https://datung.io/funders.html
